conf.description: Proofpoint PPS filter log (mail flow), syslog-kv: kv-parses sendmail/filter-module lines, derives event.duration/event.outcome/destination.address from vendor names before renaming. Per recommendations.direct.cribl, full (s,m) multi-line reassembly into one message is NOT implemented here (no safe stateful function available) - correlation ids are tagged instead and reassembly is left to Elastic; see README.

conf.comment: Proofpoint PPS filter log, syslog-kv. Parses per-line sendmail + filter-module kv pairs. Stateful (s,m) reassembly called for by recommendations.direct.cribl is a documented gap - no join stageId is available - so this emits one record per raw line, tagged with session/message correlation ids.

functions.description: why this pipeline exists and what it deliberately does not do
extract the space-delimited key=value pairs (sendmail and filter-module lines both use this grammar)
split the HH:MM:SS or d+HH:MM:SS delay string into components ahead of the nanosecond conversion
compute derived fields from the ORIGINAL vendor names before the rename step: delay to nanoseconds, outcome from the sendmail status prefix, and relay only when it is the recipient-line delivery hop
batch rename every clean-identifier vendor key: mapped ECS targets and unmapped proofpoint.pps.* custom targets together
tag the ECS data-stream dataset component (no hyphen, per constraint 5)
set _time from the line's own syslog timestamp
